hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)}" 2>/dev/null; x=native/bin/sumika-dev.exe; [ -s "$x" ] || { (cd native && go build -o bin/sumika-dev.exe.new.$$ ./cmd/sumika-dev && d=$(bin/sumika-dev.exe.new.$$ __srcdigest) && go build -ldflags "-X sumika-native/internal/devtools/selfbuild.BuiltDigest=$d" -o bin/sumika-dev.exe.new2.$$ ./cmd/sumika-dev && mv bin/sumika-dev.exe.new2.$$ bin/sumika-dev.exe; rm -f bin/sumika-dev.exe.new.$$); }; [ -s "$x" ] && env -u SUMIKA_DEV_NO_REBUILD -u SUMIKA_DEV_REEXEC_DONE -u SUMIKA_DEV_ROOT "$x" notice; exit 0
